title: The Dilworth scavenger hunt
subtitle: Saturday, May 15 at 10 AM. Free for all ages.
details_html:
Twenty clues across Dilworth. One golden duck.

Form a team of up to 4 and text us your team name.

Start at the Latta Park gazebo at 10 sharp.

Solve each clue to find the next one. Feet and bikes only.

Snap a team photo at every stop.

Carry the golden duck back to the gazebo. First team back wins the trophy, a spray-painted duck.

What to bring

A phone for photo clues, comfortable shoes, and a healthy suspicion of garden gnomes.

Rain plan

Light rain, we hunt. Downpour, we move to Sunday.
verdict_question: Did you find the golden duck?
verdict_answer: Bring it back to the gazebo!
contact_html: Text to enter your team by Friday night.
